genericBody: The request could not be completed. Trying again usually clears a transient failure.
networkBody: The connection dropped before the request finished. Check your connection, then try again.
unauthorizedBody: Sign in again to keep working. Nothing was lost.
forbiddenBody: This account does not have access to the requested resource.
notFoundBody: This app or record no longer exists. It may have been deleted.
timeoutTitle: The API did not answer in time
timeoutBody: Check that the API, database and Redis are reachable, then try again.
tooManyBody: The API refused this request because too many arrived in a short time. Try again in a moment.
serverBody: The request could not be completed. Try again in a moment.
